FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
Point zero eight is the blood alcohol level at which any driver is legally impaired, while point zero two is the level that already earns a driver under twenty-one a civil violation and suspension [A01].
Why it matters: group alcohol thresholds; difficulty high; prereq sec11-F04; confusables sec11-F04, sec11-F05
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A02
Refusing the implied consent test costs the license for at least six months on its own, separate from any penalty for a driving under the influence conviction [A02].
Why it matters: group implied consent; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F12; confusables sec11-F12, sec11-F11
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A02
Administrative suspension is a civil loss of the license that can happen before a criminal conviction, whereas the conviction itself brings the fine, class, possible jail and insurance increase [A02].
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F13; confusables sec11-F13, sec11-F11
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A03
Only time, at least one hour per drink, reduces alcohol's effects, and drinking coffee, taking a shower, or exercising cannot reduce blood alcohol concentration or the effects of alcohol [A03].
Why it matters: group sobering up; difficulty low; prereq sec11-F09; confusables sec11-F09, sec11-F16
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A03
A drowsy driver can look like a drunk driver to others, but the remedy for drowsiness is to pull over and sleep, not to open a window or raise the radio [A03].
Why it matters: group drowsy driving; difficulty low; prereq sec11-F19; confusables sec11-F22, sec11-F19
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-vt-class-std:vermont-department-of-motor-vehicles-age:handbook:pdf-0055]
